exercises.question: Which sentence uses the subjunctive correctly?
options: Es necesario que todos respeten la ley. [It is necessary that everyone respect the law.]
Es necesario que todos respetan la ley. [It is necessary that everyone respects the law.]
Es necesario que todos respetar la ley. [It is necessary for everyone to respect the law.]

exercises.sentence: Es importante que el gobierno ___ a la gente.
exercises.english: It is important that the government listens to people.
It is essential that there be clear rules.

sentences: Primero, es necesario que todos respeten la ley. [First, it is necessary that everyone respect the law.]
Además, es importante que el gobierno escuche a la gente. [Also, it is important that the government listens to people.]
Finalmente, es fundamental que haya reglas claras. [Finally, it is essential that there be clear rules.]

exercises.question: Which word means «duty»?
options: deber
permiso
regla

exercises.sentence: Es ___ que todos conozcan las reglas.
exercises.english: It is necessary that everyone knows the rules.
It is important that the government listens to people.

exercises.sentence: Es necesario que todos respeten la ley.
options: It is necessary that everyone respect the law.
Everyone respected the law yesterday.
Everyone will ignore the law.

exercises.sentence: Es fundamental que haya reglas claras.
options: It is essential that there be clear rules.
It is essential that there were no rules.
Clear rules are forbidden in this place.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que el gobierno escuche a la gente.
exercises.english: It is important that the government listens to the people.

options: Es necesario que todos lean las reglas. [It is necessary that everyone reads the rules.]
Es necesario que todos leen las reglas. [It is necessary that everyone reads the rules.]
Es necesario que todos leer las reglas. [It is necessary for everyone to read the rules.]
Es fundamental que haya reglas claras. [It is essential that there be clear rules.]
Es fundamental que hay reglas claras. [It is essential that there are clear rules.]
Es fundamental que haber reglas. [It is essential to have rules.]

template.prompt: Say that it is necessary that everyone respects the law (use the subjunctive).
template.answer: Es necesario que todos respeten la ley.

template.prompt: Say that it is essential that there be clear rules.
template.answer: Es fundamental que haya reglas claras.

template.prompt: Say that it is important that the government listens to the people.
template.answer: Es importante que el gobierno escuche a la gente.
